from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single company's financial expense data extracted from a quarterly report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company as stated in the document")
    financial_expense_amount: float | None = Field(description="The reported financial expense value (positive for net expenditure, negative for net income)")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The time period covered by the financial data (e.g., '2025 Q1')")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit used in the report (e.g., '元', 'CNY')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates all financial records extracted from the document collection."""
    records: list[CompanyFinancialRecord]
